name: com.tencent.timpush.xiaomi.TIMXiaoMiService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Xiaomi push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it registers the app's configured credentials with Xiaomi's push service.
disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration stops, and a later registration result from the still-enabled Xiaomi receiver can fail because this provider is missing.
